en.headline: 3 own commits plus 17 automated in sogeisetsu, 2 discussions started
en.summary: On 2026-10-13, the user made **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus **17 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` in the same repository. The three own commits all touched the daily-report pipeline: one added a regression test locking `generateNarrative` so it no longer self-gates on `empty`, one removed a duplicated `empty` gate at the AI layer and filled in the missing regression cases, and one fixed a bug where blank days were swallowing the `discussion` and other appended sections. No pull requests, reviews, issues, releases, stars, or replies were recorded for the day. The user also started 2 discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`: #4823 `[Idea] Expose session context and usage stats to extensions via the SDK` and #4821 `[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel`, both in the Ideas category with 0 comments so far. No truncation flags were hit on any section.
